oneLine: CivicState has code, not proof; brooks-history identity mismatch blocks investibility.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sourcesAndMethods.method: Used project id, registry sensitivity, scrutiny gaps, workspace-only constraints, and current date as evidence.
Extracted CivicState thesis, pricing, financial assumptions, competition, compliance boundaries, and unit economics.
Compared PROJECT, GENESIS, REQUIREMENTS, ROADMAP, STATE, and existing-state for current narrative and contradictions.
Inspected Next.js page, Express routes, Prisma schema, and worker agents to distinguish implemented surfaces from aspiration.

currentThesis.summary: CivicState may be a small paid constituent-letter workflow business if users pay and delivery works; the dispatch/repo identity mismatch prevents an investible claim today.

businessModel.customer: US resident with a specific civic issue and low willingness to do official lookup, legal research, drafting, and delivery manually [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]
businessModel.grossMarginTarget: 85.1% to 92.0% contribution margin range in the upgraded model [assumption/evidence mixed: BUSINESS.md financial table]

financials.breakEven: $340 MRR and about 25 Amplify submissions/month [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]
financials.knownWeakness: Human review cost is not proven and could materially reduce contribution margin [assumption: BUSINESS.md]

marketSizing.method: bottom-up paid submissions times average revenue per submission
marketSizing.launchReachable: 400 submissions/month times $18 ARPS equals $7,200/month [assumption: MASTER_PLAN.md scenario, not external evidence]
marketSizing.nicheUpside: 1,200 submissions/month times $20 ARPS equals $24,000/month [assumption: MASTER_PLAN.md scenario, not external evidence]
marketSizing.vcScaleVerdict: not venture-scale on workspace evidence alone

competition: Resistbot [assumption: model knowledge; named in MASTER_PLAN.md]
Change.org [assumption: model knowledge; named in MASTER_PLAN.md]
LegalZoom [assumption: model knowledge; named in MASTER_PLAN.md]
Quorum / VoterVoice [assumption: model knowledge from .planning/PROJECT.md context]
risks: Project identity mismatch: dispatch says brooks-history, repo says CivicState [evidence: dispatch; package.json].
Registry says personal/research asset and not near-term investible BOS [evidence: dispatch registry note].
No repo evidence of paying customers or live production revenue [evidence: .planning/existing-state.md].
Government email deliverability and official contact coverage are unvalidated [assumption: no live evidence in workspace].
Compliance route appears to reference fields absent from Prisma models [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/compliance.ts; packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma].

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Require operator ruling before wrk.vc publication.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: The correct asset may not be CivicState.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Run paid beta with explicit conversion and refund tracking.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Residents may not pay even if the workflow works.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Smoke test Postmark, opt-out, suppression, and compliance routes before launch.
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Official complaints or spam filtering may make email-only delivery nonviable.

roadmap.buildableShape: 8 unchecked single-worker items aligned to BUSINESS.md headings [evidence: ROADMAP.md]

operatorAdoption.reason: Status remains proposed until operator merge upgrades authority.
